q1: SELECT NAME AS CUSTOMERS FROM CUSTOMERS WHERE ID NOT IN (SELECT CUSTOMERID FROM ORDERS)
q2: SELECT NAME AS CUSTOMERS FROM ( SELECT A.*, B.CUSTOMERID FROM CUSTOMERS A LEFT JOIN ORDERS B ON A.ID=B.CUSTOMERID ) A WHERE A.CUSTOMERID IS NULL
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT NAME AS CUSTOMERS FROM CUSTOMERS WHERE ID NOT IN (SELECT CUSTOMERID FROM ORDERS)

explanation: Both queries are designed to find customers who have not made any orders. They achieve this by checking for NULL values in the CUSTOMERID column of the ORDERS table, which indicates that the customer has no associated orders.
